warnings: This drawing set prints NO grid bubbles — only dimension chains. Labels were assigned here (same convention as house 70): numbers 1-4 on the four column lines along x (every 2.50), letters A-B on the two column rows along y (3.00 apart, A = the row on the C0-F3 / G5 side, drawn at the top of S-01). Every named line carries grid_label_assigned_not_printed. Origin A1 (top-left column).

On S-01 the 1.20 ticks above A and below B land on the OUTER face of the edge beam G1 rather than its centre (by scale about 0.10 m off). They are recorded as the edge-beam line A''' / B'' because S-03 dimensions the cantilevers G2/1, G3/1 as 1.20 to their tip and S-02 / S-04 use the same 1.20 for the eave edge.
The top S-01 segment is printed '~0.20' (with a tilde) from the SO slab edge to the C0-F3 / G5 line — recorded 0.20, line A' flagged approximate.

Every printed x/y tick became a line (section 4 rule 4): the S-02 rafter-spacing chains add 1''', 1'''', 1''''', 2', 3', 3'', 4' on x and A'''', A''''', A'''''', A''''''', B' on y. Before-origin dummies share the first main grid's prime sequence.

z: the only printed levels are +0.00 (ground), +0.20 (SO), +0.32 (structural top of the precast floor, S-01) and +0.40 (floor finish, section 1-1). The section 1-1 chain 0.40 / 2.90 / 0.30 / 0.90 and the S-04 truss chain 0.30 / 0.90 give three unlabelled levels, kept as dummies +3.30 / +3.60 / +4.50.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-04 (หน้า12-15) plus the main level / grid chains of section 1-1 (หน้า06). The other architectural / sanitary sheets were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run; S-03 prints only member-internal dimensions (section sizes, footing plans and depths), which stay on their elements.
Scanned set; every PDF page is stored rotated 270 deg — read in the PDF's own display orientation (title block at the bottom).
